summary.text: Casey Carlisle is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 148 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent David A. Dolan.
Carlisle is a Sikeston native who, according to her Ballotpedia survey responses, spent five years as a 911 emergency dispatcher.

paragraphs.text: Casey Carlisle graduated from Sikeston Senior High School, and her career experience includes working in healthcare.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born and raised in Sikeston, graduated in 2006, attended Three Rivers community college and has served the community in various roles, most notably as a 911 emergency dispatcher for five years.

In her survey responses, Carlisle said her key messages include improving public education funding and teacher pay, taxing the wealthy rather than eliminating the income tax and raising sales taxes, expanding Medicaid, and guaranteeing reproductive rights.
She listed Indivisible SEMO as an endorser.
